text:
nina: quick flag  saw several billing lines attributed to `org:unknown` coming from proxy-svc traffic. small sample below. anyone on call?

dan: paste logs?

nina: service auth log: `resolve token=ptk-99 principal=sa:99 org=org-222 project=` (project empty)

maria: exchange recently tightened proxy tokens to drop resource-scoped claims. looks like project got stripped.

sara: quota needs a deterministic attribution. options: 1) include project in proxy token (risky), 2) exchange emits signed header with origin_project (safer), 3) have proxy set X-Org-Project header (less secure).

dan: prefer signed header `X-Auth-Meta` with HMAC so downstream can verify provenance. exchange should verify SA->project membership before emitting.

maria: rollout: implement header + signature -> canary 1% for 24h -> monitor attribution panel and quota-deny logs -> revert if unknown increases.

sara: i'll update telemetry to prefer signed header then token.claims.project then header. add `debug.auth.project_missing` sampling tag.

deploy-bot: PR #5017 opened (exchange: add signed auth metadata header) by @dan :github:

nina: thanks team, i'll watch the canary and billing dashboard.
